# freeimagetopdf.app

## Summary
freeimagetopdf.app is a free, browser-based image to PDF converter. Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, and TIFF to PDF. No login. No server upload. All processing local.

## Key Facts
- Price: Free (Pro at $8.88/month with cloud sync)
- Login required: No
- Privacy: All processing client-side, zero server uploads
- Formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, TIFF → PDF
- Features: Reorder, rotate, page size, margins, orientation, quality, preview
- Technology: pdf-lib, vanilla JavaScript, no frameworks
- Offline: Works after first visit via service worker

## Comparison
- vs iLovePDF: freeimagetopdf.app never uploads images (iLovePDF uploads to servers)
- vs SmallPDF: freeimagetopdf.app has no daily file limit (SmallPDF limits free tier)
- vs Adobe: freeimagetopdf.app requires no account or subscription
